page_title: MON 2-2 WER | B. Monchengladbach v Werder Bremen 15/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Felix Zwayer is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+4' Rafael Borre goes off the pitch and Dawid Kownacki (Werder Bremen) comes on.
90+4' Here comes the VAR decision. Referee Felix Zwayer produces a yellow card from his pocket and Christoph Kramer (B. Monchengladbach) looks mighty relieved!

90+3' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Christoph Kramer (B. Monchengladbach), but referee Felix Zwayer must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
90+2' The game is interrupted by the referee. He pulls out a red card and sends Christoph Kramer (B. Monchengladbach) off.
90+1' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
90' Substitution. Yvandro Borges Sanches (B. Monchengladbach) replaces Alassane Plea.
88' The linesman signals that Anthony Jung (Werder Bremen) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
88' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.

88' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. Werder Bremen have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
87' Gerardo Seoane has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Grant-Leon Ranos (B. Monchengladbach) replacing Franck Honorat.
87' Gerardo Seoane prepares a substitution. Manu Kone is replaced by Florian Neuhaus (B. Monchengladbach).
86' Substitution. Felix Agu (Werder Bremen) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Olivier Deman walks off.
85' B. Monchengladbach are ruled offside.
84' Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Felix Zwayer has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. B. Monchengladbach have a free kick.
81' Here is a change. Robin Hack is going off and Gerardo Seoane gives the last tactical orders to Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach).
81' The substitution is prepared. Christoph Kramer (B. Monchengladbach) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Rocco Reitz.
79' A cross from Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
76' 2 - 2 It's 2:2! Justin Njinmah feeds Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the bottom left corner.
73' Milos Veljkovic (Werder Bremen) sends a long ball in, but Moritz Nicolas comfortably gathers the ball.
72' Felix Zwayer blows his whistle. Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) commits a foul after dangerous play.
70' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) launches himself at a lofted pass, but his close-range header flies just wide of the left post.
68' Ole Werner has decided to substitute Romano Schmid and he is replaced by Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen).
68' The substitution has been made. Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) has replaced Leonardo Bittencourt.

67' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) attempts to find one of his teammates with a cross from the resultant free kick, but he fails to hit the ball properly and sends it off the pitch. The ball goes out of play and B. Monchengladbach will have a goal kick.
66' The foul by Julian Weigl (B. Monchengladbach) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Felix Zwayer.

65' Rafael Borre (Werder Bremen) flashes a header well wide of the left post following a lofted pass into the centre of the box. The ball goes out of play and B. Monchengladbach will have a goal kick.
63' Milos Veljkovic (Werder Bremen) sends a cross into the box, but Moritz Nicolas comes off his line to gather the ball.

61' CHANCE! Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) picks up a pass inside the box and has a sight of goal, but he sends his shot well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Werder Bremen.
60' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) sends a long ball in, but Moritz Nicolas comfortably gathers the ball.

59' Fine attempt! Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) collects a pass and manages to hold off the defender, then rifles in a shot from mid-range which unluckily swerves inches past the left post. The ball goes out of play and Werder Bremen will have a goal kick.

57' Manu Kone (B. Monchengladbach) attempted to send a defence-splitting pass into space where Franck Honorat was lurking. It could have put him one-on-one with the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players somehow manages to avert the threat.
55' The foul by Julian Weigl (B. Monchengladbach) was seen by Felix Zwayer who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.

53' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for B. Monchengladbach.
51' Felix Zwayer shows the yellow card to Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) for a heavy challenge.
49' 2 - 1 Goal! Robin Hack tees up Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the bottom right corner. 2:1.
47' Christoph Kramer (B. Monchengladbach) picks up a yellow card.

47' Michael Zetterer makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) inside the box and he strikes goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of the bottom right corner.
47' Manu Kone (B. Monchengladbach) fires a shot from close range, but he is somehow only able to hit the right post!
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+7' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+6' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) was probably a bit loose with his words to Felix Zwayer, who decides to show him a yellow.
45+6' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) has too much to say to the referee and receives a caution.
45+5' Felix Zwayer blows his whistle and it's Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
45+1' 6 additional min. will be played.

45' 1 - 1 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner. His attempt was beyond the reach of Michael Zetterer. 1:1.
45' Manu Kone (B. Monchengladbach) looks to pass after collecting a rebound, but a lack of options forces him to shoot from distance and it's easily blocked by an opponent.
44' The game is interrupted now, Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

42' Rafael Borre plays a beautiful lofted pass to Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen), who somehow crashes the ball miles over the bar from a promising position. The ball goes out of play and B. Monchengladbach will have a goal kick.
40' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Felix Zwayer who sees an offensive foul.
39' Close! Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) unleashes a rocket of a shot from the edge of the box and his shot flies just a few inches over the crossbar.
38' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for B. Monchengladbach.
34' Maximilian Wober (B. Monchengladbach) picks up a yellow card for a foul.
34' B. Monchengladbach failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

34' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. B. Monchengladbach force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
32' Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach) sends in the corner, but the keeper steps in and makes a save.
30' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by B. Monchengladbach, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
30' Handball! A player from Werder Bremen handled the ball.

27' Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) meets a cross from the flank and pulls the trigger from the edge of the box, but the ball flies high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Werder Bremen.

25' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the middle of the net is denied by Moritz Nicolas. This effort really didn't trouble him. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for B. Monchengladbach.
22' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
21' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders. The referee points to the corner flag and Werder Bremen will take a corner.
18' The game gets underway again after that interruption.
14' The game is interrupted.

11' Maximilian Wober (B. Monchengladbach) climbs above the defence to meet the free kick, but plants his header high over the bar from close range. The ball goes out of play and Werder Bremen will have a goal kick.
10' Felix Zwayer has a clear sight and sees a foul from Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen). B. Monchengladbach earn a free kick.
10' A quickly taken corner by B. Monchengladbach.

9' The resulting set piece from B. Monchengladbach is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to B. Monchengladbach.
7' 0 - 1 Goal! Romano Schmid puts a cross into the box and finds Rafael Borre (Werder Bremen), who latches on to it and strikes the ball into the bottom right corner. He makes it 0:1.
6' Rafael Borre (Werder Bremen) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
4' It's a nice effort by Rafael Borre (Werder Bremen) from the edge of the box, but it's low towards the middle of the goal and straight down the throat of Moritz Nicolas. Easy save.

1' Manu Kone (B. Monchengladbach) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a decent low shot from the edge of the box towards the middle of the net, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Werder Bremen will take the kick-off.
Felix Zwayer got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
